messages.workbench.catalog-board.ex.pp-s1-text:
An unbroken stretch of time suits deep thought far better than many scattered gaps.

Today I tried leaving my phone in another room, keeping only a book, paper, and a glass of water. Halfway through, the urge to look something up came three times. I jotted each question in the margin and kept reading.

By the end of the chapter, two of those questions had answered themselves. A habit worth keeping: walk one stretch first, then fill in the map afterward.
